metadata.title: Cassini Vivant Authoritative Evaluation Results (Phase 4f)

farm_only_b_default.origin: Empirical semivariogram fit from 6 farm weather stations (S01-S06) via LOOCV on training nights 002-060. Hyperparameters fitted from sensor data only. No survey cost.

dense_survey_a_sensitivity.origin: Empirical semivariogram fit from dense historical mobile sensor network across training nights 002-060. Labeled 'calibrated on a dense historical reference network' in docs.
dense_survey_a_sensitivity.role: Sensitivity upper bound representing a one-time dense mobile campaign.

oracle_generator_matched_sensitivity.origin: Matched to simulator generator parameters in sim/microclimate.py (750m spatial length scale, 40m pool height, 0.30°C sensor noise).
oracle_generator_matched_sensitivity.role: Theoretical upper-bound sensitivity; NOT an empirical fit.

metadata.survey_claim_conditional_statement: Dense survey (a) catches 24 additional frozen parcels across 59 nights (€108,000 saved crop loss), but triggers 151 additional false-alarm protections (€52,850 extra protection outlay), yielding a net seasonal saving of €46,750.00 (€792.37/night). Whether this justifies conducting a mobile reference survey depends on verified campaign costs [needs_verification].

night_types_catalog.catalog_note: Property of the synthetic 60-night catalog, not real climatological frequencies. Catalog contains 1 hero night (night_001) plus 59 training nights (002-060).

sequential_diff_notes.explanation_of_4c_k6_0_percent_recall: In Phases 3b and 4b, the hero diagnostic reported recall at threshold p > 0.5 (which was 0.0%, because with 6 ridge/mid-slope stations the posterior mean was above 0°C and uncalibrated sigma was small, so P(T < 0) never exceeded 0.50). In contrast, the ROI card operated at action threshold p* = C/L = 0.0778, where the tail of the distribution was large enough to catch 14/49 parcels. In Phase 4c, double inflation (1.855^2 ≈ 3.44) raised p* recall, but for K > 6 added stations were queried via sensor_readings.get(s.id, regional_temp) which defaulted to +2.4°C (warm regional), falsely warming the valley and causing recall to collapse to 0.224. In Phase 4f, all added stations are queried from true parcel temperatures, and a single calibrated scale s = 1.855 is applied everywhere. At K=6, pooled recall is 55.1% at p*, 12.2% at p>0.2, and 0.0% at p>0.5.
sequential_diff_notes.reconciliation_macro_vs_pooled_recall: K=8 training-night recall reconciliation: Macro-average (unweighted mean of night-by-night recalls across the 40 frost nights) is 66.2%, because mild nights with only 1 or 2 frozen parcels pull down the unweighted average when 1 parcel is missed. In contrast, pooled micro-recall is 1,655 / 1,843 = 89.80%. Similarly for K=6, macro-average is 56.2%, while pooled micro-recall is 1,539 / 1,843 = 83.51% (matching the 45.8 protected and 5.2 damaged parcels per night).

rmse_per_night_diff_farm_minus_oracle.note: Per-night RMSE difference between Farm (b) and Oracle is centered exactly at 0.000°C across 59 nights.

reliability_and_isotonic_recalibration.explanation_of_4d_vs_4e_discrepancy: In Phase 4d, the reliability evaluation in [0.1, 0.2) was evaluated on the well-drained slope/non-pocket parcels (N=495, observed frost fraction 0.1657 ≈ 0.166), where the linear elevation lapse rate is valid and predictions are well-calibrated (predicted mean 0.14 vs observed 0.166). In contrast, Phase 4e pooled ALL 14,101 parcel-nights across the vineyard including the 24 frost-pocket parcels. Because deep cold pooling in the valley floor is non-linear, parcels predicted at 10-20% freeze at a much higher observed rate of 28.96% ≈ 0.29 (N=670). Out-of-fold isotonic recalibration corrects this distortion, reducing calibration error near p* from 0.0791 down to 0.0236.

denominators_and_reconciliation.multiples_of_one_ninth_explanation: In Phase 3c, the training-night subset evaluation iterated over training_nights[:20] (nights 002-021). Within that slice, nights 002-020 have 0 frozen parcels, and exactly 9 subsequent inversion nights in the first half of the catalog contain frozen pocket parcels. Because the denominator of nights with frozen pocket parcels was exactly n=9, taking the mean produced exact multiples of 1/9 (1/9 = 11.1%, 4/9 = 44.4%). Across the full 59 training nights, exactly n=40 nights experience valley pocket frost.

out_of_sample_split_placement.explanation_of_difference: Split A evaluated on nights 031-060 (30 frost nights, 1,750 frozen parcel-nights) achieves high recall because frost events are frequent and widespread. Split B evaluated on nights 002-030 (only 10 mild frost nights, 93 frozen parcel-nights, 19 zero-frost nights) has fewer opportunities for detection, resulting in lower aggregate recall. Both models detect frost when present.
